```{css}
.rt-td-inner > a {
  color: inherit !important;
}

.rt-td-filter {
	border-bottom: none;
}

.ReactTable {
  background: transparent;
  margin-left: 5%;
  margin-right: 5%;
}

/* reactable clips cells/inners with overflow:hidden and scrolls the table body;
   override those (with enough specificity to beat reactable.css) so the open
   filter dropdown can spill out, and keep the header above the body rows. */
.Reactable .rt-table,
.Reactable .rt-thead,
.Reactable .rt-tr-filters,
.Reactable .rt-td-filter,
.Reactable .rt-td-filter .rt-td-inner {
  overflow: visible !important;
}

.Reactable .rt-thead {
  z-index: 3;
}

.Reactable .rt-td-filter:has(.multi-filter[open]) {
  z-index: 4;
}

.multi-filter {
  position: relative;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.multi-filter > summary {
  list-style: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border: 1px solid #ccc;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: white;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.multi-filter > summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

.multi-filter > summary::after {
  content: "▾";
  float: right;
  margin-left: 6px;
}

.multi-filter__menu {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 1000;
  left: 0;
  margin-top: 2px;
  max-height: 220px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  background: white;
  border: 1px solid #ccc;
  border-radius: 4px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}

.multi-filter__option {
  display: block;
  white-space: nowrap;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.multi-filter__option:hover {
  background: #f2f2f2;
}

.multi-filter__option > input {
  margin-right: 6px;
}

.resources-text {
  margin-left: 5%;
  margin-right: 5%;
}

/* Quarto promotes the "# Resources" heading into the page title block, which
   sits in the narrow centred body-content column while the intro text lives in
   a full-width `.column-screen`. Span the title across the same full-width grid
   track and inset it 5% so the heading lines up with `.resources-text`. */
#title-block-header {
  grid-column: screen-start / screen-end;
  padding-left: 5%;
  padding-right: 5%;
}
```

::: {.resources-text}

If you want to add entries to this table or correct existing ones, please reach out to [info@palaeoverse.org](mailto:info@palaeoverse.org).

```{r}
library(brand.yml)
library(htmltools)
library(googlesheets4)
library(reactable)

gs4_deauth()

brand <- read_brand_yml()

dat <- read_sheet(
  "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w0K1gWOBQjMH6q5pYGkY7FNFyBjNt42Pbv9N2JFbquc/edit?gid=0#gid=0"
) |>
  as.data.frame()

dropdown_with_checkboxes <- colDef(
  filterInput = function(values, name) {
    tags$details(
      class = "multi-filter",
      "data-col" = name,
      tags$summary(sprintf("Filter %s", name)),
      tags$div(
        class = "multi-filter__menu",
        lapply(sort(unique(values)), function(value) {
          tags$label(
            class = "multi-filter__option",
            tags$input(
              type = "checkbox",
              value = value,
              # Collect every ticked box; clear the filter when none are ticked.
              onchange = sprintf(
                "var picked = Array.from(this.closest('.multi-filter').querySelectorAll('input:checked')).map(function(c) { return c.value; }); Reactable.setFilter('external-resources', '%s', picked.length ? picked : undefined)",
                name
              )
            ),
            value
          )
        })
      )
    )
  },
  filterMethod = JS(
    "function(rows, columnId, filterValue) {
    return rows.filter(function(row) {
      return filterValue.includes(row.values[columnId]);
    });
  }"
  )
)


reactable(
  dat,
  elementId = "external-resources",
  columns = list(
    Category = dropdown_with_checkboxes,
    Type = dropdown_with_checkboxes,
    Link = colDef(cell = function(value) {
      htmltools::tags$a(href = value, target = "_blank", value)
    })
  ),
  filterable = TRUE,
  searchable = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
# Make the dropdowns interdependent: each column's checkboxes only show values
# that still exist in the rows passing the OTHER dropdowns' current selections.
htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::tags$script(htmltools::HTML(paste0(
    "window.__extData = ",
    jsonlite::toJSON(dat[, c("Category", "Type")], dataframe = "rows"),
    ";"
  ))),
  htmltools::tags$script(htmltools::HTML("
(function() {
  var cols = ['Category', 'Type'];
  function selected(col) {
    var set = new Set();
    document
      .querySelectorAll('.multi-filter[data-col=' + col + '] input[type=checkbox]:checked')
      .forEach(function(c) { set.add(c.value); });
    return set;
  }
  function update() {
    var data = window.__extData || [];
    cols.forEach(function(col) {
      var others = cols
        .filter(function(c) { return c !== col; })
        .map(function(c) { return { col: c, set: selected(c) }; });
      var available = new Set();
      data.forEach(function(row) {
        var keep = others.every(function(o) {
          return o.set.size === 0 || o.set.has(row[o.col]);
        });
        if (keep) available.add(row[col]);
      });
      document
        .querySelectorAll('.multi-filter[data-col=' + col + '] .multi-filter__option')
        .forEach(function(opt) {
          var cb = opt.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]');
          opt.style.display = (available.has(cb.value) || cb.checked) ? '' : 'none';
        });
    });
  }
  function init() {
    if (!document.querySelector('.multi-filter input[type=checkbox]')) {
      setTimeout(init, 300);
      return;
    }
    document.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
      if (e.target.matches && e.target.matches('.multi-filter input[type=checkbox]')) {
        update();
      }
    });
    // Close any open dropdown when clicking outside of it.
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.multi-filter[open]').forEach(function(d) {
        if (!d.contains(e.target)) d.open = false;
      });
    });
    update();
  }
  if (document.readyState !== 'loading') init();
  else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
})();
"))
)
```
